narrative.northStar: Taiwan Topographic Field Guide & Transit Timetable
narrative.overview:
The design system translates Taiwanese visual culture — deep Taiwan Indigo/Navy, Temple Vermilion, and crisp daylight paper — into an ISO control-description travel guide and transit pocket timetable. Peripheral contour ornament sits strictly inside the masthead, leaving the main reading column crisp white for outdoor legibility on mobile phones.

Instead of rounded card stacks, duplicate text boxes, or cluttered multi-button rows beside thumbnails, schedules pair tabular left-gutter hours with a unified full-width .place-bar below the content row: a single Traditional Chinese utility chip (opening the fullscreen Driver/Copy dialog on genuine car/taxi/bus/hotel stops, or instant tap-to-copy on walking/MRT/charter stops) beside a compact 44x44px icon-only Google Maps pin, alongside semantic condition icons, Wikimedia landmark thumbnails, and a scannable Taiwanese shopping catalog illustrated in a unified gouache-and-ink style.
keyCharacteristics: 75% Daylight Paper (#FFFFFF / #F6F5F2), 18% Taiwan Cultural Navy (#14365D), and 7% Temple Vermilion (#B8232A).
Single-row sticky [ทุกวัน] + (D0)–(D7) course rail with one-tap day filtering and automatic today-focus during the trip.
Unified .place-bar utility pattern: 44px Traditional Chinese chip (is-driver vs is-copy) + 44x44px icon-only Google Maps pin with zero redundant standalone Driver buttons.
Sharp 0px architectural keylines across tables, shopping cards, and buttons (50% circles solely for D0–D7 control markers).
Hybrid visual system pairing 21 cropped landscape Wikimedia landmark photos (640x360 WebP) with 13 cohesive gouache culinary illustrations (480x360 WebP).

rules.name: The Daylight Column Rule
rules.body: Topographic contour ornament stays inside the peripheral masthead; the reading column remains pure Paper White (#FFFFFF) with >=4.5:1 text contrast.

rules.name: The Vermilion Restraint Rule
rules.body: Temple Vermilion (#B8232A) marks active today states, route emphasis, and MRT Red Line badges (~7% surface coverage), leaving structural navigation in Taiwan Navy (#14365D) and warnings in Amber.

rules.name: The Zero-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings (h1, h2, h3) always come first with zero eyebrow labels above them; badges and meta tags sit inline or below.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Schedule tables, shopping cards, and buttons carry zero drop shadow at rest.

dos: Do keep body copy >=16px, interactive controls >=44px, and text contrast >=4.5:1 outdoors.
Do pair semantic inline SVGs with each condition or action (never repeat unrelated icons or Unicode emoji).
Do embed provenance sidecars (.webp.json) on every raster asset and use native <dialog closedby="any">.
donts: Don't place kickers or metadata pills above h1, h2, or h3 headings.
Don't duplicate place titles or Chinese strings into redundant boxes below descriptions.
Don't publish private info (ages, personal health/dietary notes, booking refs, budgets, cut lists, [ต้องเช็ก], or planner To-dos).
